rmi: rmi — to weep (verb; written with the weeping eye)
psg: psg — to spit, spit on (verb; written with the man with hand to mouth; the reading is not sure; Budge: pesaḳ, 'wash')
ḫpdt: ḫpdt — hindquarters, rump (?) (noun f.; the reading and sense follow Budge's χepṭet and are not sure)
mḥt-wrt: mḥt-wrt — Mehet-weret, 'the Great Flood', the sky as a cow in the waters, mother of the sun (goddess's name; Budge: Meḥ-urt)
ṯs-pẖr: ṯs-pẖr — and vice versa, conversely (phrase; ṯs 'tie' + pẖr 'turn round'; closes a statement that holds both ways; Budge: θes rer)
nwy: nwy — water, flood, the waters (noun; written with the pot nw and water classifiers; Budge: ennui)
imsty: imsty — Imsety, one of the four sons of Horus, who guard the dead man's inner organs (god's name; also written msṯi; Budge: Mesthà)
ḥpy: ḥpy — Hapy, one of the four sons of Horus (god's name; not the Nile flood ḥꜥpy; Budge: Ḥāpi)
dwꜣ-mwt-f: dwꜣ-mwt-f — Duamutef, 'He who adores his mother', one of the four sons of Horus (god's name; Budge: Ṭuamāutef)
qbḥ-snw-f: qbḥ-snw-f — Qebehsenuf, 'He who refreshes his brothers', one of the four sons of Horus (god's name; Budge: Qebḥsennuf)
ḥtp-sḫws: ḥtp-sḫws — Hetep-sekhus, a fiery goddess, the Eye of Ra (goddess's name; the meaning of the name is not clear; Budge: Ḥetep-sekhus)
spꜣ: spꜣ — Sepa, a god written with the centipede (god's name; Budge: Sepa)

m-sꜣ: m-sꜣ — behind, after (compound preposition: m 'in' + sꜣ 'back')
ḫpš: ḫpš — foreleg, thigh (of an ox); the Foreleg, the constellation of the Great Bear in the northern sky (noun m.; Budge: χepeś, 'the Thigh')
sꜣm: sꜣm — to burn (verb; written with the flame; sꜣmt, the infinitive or a noun 'burning'; Budge: samt)
mꜣꜣ-itf-f: mꜣꜣ-itf-f — Maa-itef-ef, 'He who sees his father', one of the seven spirits (god's name; Budge: Maa-atef-f)
ẖry-bꜣq-f: ẖry-bꜣq-f — Khery-baqef, 'He who is under his moringa tree', one of the seven spirits (god's name; Budge: Kheri-beq-f)
ḥr-ḫnty-irty: ḥr-ḫnty-irty — Horus-Khenty-irty, 'Horus Foremost of the Two Eyes', a form of Horus (god's name; Budge: Ḥeru-khenti-maa)
nḏḥ-nḏḥ: nḏḥ-nḏḥ — Nedjeh-nedjeh, one of the seven spirits (god's name; meaning not clear; Budge: Net'eḥ-net'eḥ)
iꜣqd-qd: iꜣqd-qd — Iaqed-qed, one of the seven spirits (god's name; meaning not clear; reading doubtful; Budge: Àaqeṭqeṭ)
in-rdi-n-f-bs-f-ḫnty-hh-f: in-rdi-n-f-bs-f-ḫnty-hh-f — In-redi-nef-besef-khenty-hehef, one of the seven spirits; the name holds rdi 'give', bs 'flame', ḫnty 'foremost' and hh 'heat' (?), its sense not clear (god's name; first sign unidentified; Budge: Àn-erṭā-nef-bes-f-khenti-heh-f)
ꜥq-ḥr-imy-wnwt-f: ꜥq-ḥr-imy-wnwt-f — Aq-her-imy-unutef, one of the seven spirits; the name holds ꜥq 'enter', ḥr 'face', imy 'who is in' and wnwt 'hour', its sense not clear (god's name; Budge: Āq-ḥer-àmmi-unnut-f)
dšr-irty-imy-ḥwt-ins: dšr-irty-imy-ḥwt-ins — Desher-irty-imy-hut-ines, 'Red of eyes, who is in the house of red linen' (?), one of the seven spirits (god's name; reading doubtful; Budge: Ṭesher-maa-àmmi-ḥet-Ànes)
wbs-ḥr-pr-m-ḫtḫt: wbs-ḥr-pr-m-ḫtḫt — Webes-her-per-em-khetkhet, one of the seven spirits; ḥr 'face', pr 'who comes forth' and m ḫtḫt 'backwards' (?) are clear, wbs is not (god's name; Budge: Ubes-ḥrà-per-em-khetkhet)
mꜣꜣ-m-grḥ-in-n-f-m-hrw: mꜣꜣ-m-grḥ-in-n-f-m-hrw — Maa-em-gereh-in-nef-em-heru, 'He who sees by night and brings by day' (?), one of the seven spirits (god's name; reading doubtful; Budge: Maa-em-ḳerḥ-àn-nef-em-hru)
irwd: irwd — a word written with the house classifier, a building or place, not identified (noun; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: àruṭ, 'hall')
pf: pf — that (masculine demonstrative, after its noun; fem. tf)
ṯꜣfy: ṯꜣfy — the Two Tjafi (?), a pair of gods (dual name; reading uncertain; Budge: T'afi, 'the two Tchafi')

__broaden__.hꜣb: hꜣb — to be harmed, suffer loss (?) (verb; not otherwise known in this sense, and not hꜣb 'send'; reading and meaning uncertain; Budge: hab) · a second word of the same spelling: to send, send out (verb; Budge: habi, 'made to depart')
__broaden__.mr: mr — canal, channel, pool (noun) · a second word of the same spelling: to be ill, sick; sickness (verb, noun; written with the hoe mr and the bird of bad things)
__broaden__.sn: sn — two (numeral; sp sn 'twice', written after a word to be said twice) · a second word of the same spelling: brother; companion, fellow (noun m.; written with the arrowhead sn)
__broaden__.wḏꜣ: wḏꜣ — to proceed, go on, set out (verb) · a second word of the same spelling: to be sound, prosper (verb; ꜥnḫ wḏꜣ snb 'life, prosperity, health') · also the noun 'soundness, well-being' (noun m.)
__broaden__.nn: nn — not, there is not (negative particle; nn + noun 'there is no …'; nn + sḏm·f 'will not …', the negative of the future; nn with a sentence without a verb 'there is not, … is not') · a second word of the same spelling: these, those (demonstrative pronoun before its noun, in classical Egyptian joined to it by the genitive n, nn n X; in later texts also without it) · the demonstrative also written nnw, with the pot nw and w, and standing first in a sentence without a verb, 'this is …' (later spelling)
__broaden__.mk: mk — behold, see (particle) · also written m·tn, mtn 'behold', when more than one person is addressed (particle with the suffix ·tn)
__broaden__.wꜥb: wꜥb — to be pure, clean; to purify oneself, bathe (verb); pure (adjective) · also wꜥb 'wab-priest', the 'pure one', a priest of the ordinary rank (noun) · also wꜥb 'purification, purity' (noun) · also wꜥbt 'the pure place', the place of embalming (noun f.; written with the house)
